tools.name: list_vendors
tools.description: Free. List or search the vendors 60SecMonitor tracks (slug, name, category), paged. Use it before paying to confirm a vendor is tracked and to get its exact slug. Read-only; one request to 60SecMonitor, no payment.

tools.name: validate_vendor
tools.description: Free. Check that a vendor name, slug or domain is well-formed and see how it will be matched. Format only and offline (no network request, no payment); use list_vendors to confirm the vendor is actually tracked.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Free. Return the price of every paid tool, the payment network (Base), the receiving address and the data source. No input, no network request, no payment.

tools.name: vendor_status
tools.description: Check whether one SaaS or cloud vendor (e.g. Stripe) is down right now: current status, confidence, active incidents, 30-day uptime and how fresh the data is, read live from 60SecMonitor. Use it for one vendor; use multi_vendor_status for up to 25 vendors at a flat price. Call list_vendors (free) fi

tools.name: multi_vendor_status
tools.description: Check the status of up to 25 SaaS or cloud vendors in one call, for "is my stack down?" questions: per-vendor status and a list of the ones not operational, read live from 60SecMonitor. Use vendor_status when you need incident detail for a single vendor. Untracked names are reported, not fatal. Not
